# Restaurant Table Reservation System (RTRS)

Multi-tenant restaurant, salon, and event reservation SaaS operated by **Vibespot Technologies Ltd. (Ghana)**
Built with Node + Express + Sequelize + MySQL backend and Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite frontend.
Ghana locale (GHS), Paystack payments, WhatsApp ordering, ShaQ Express delivery, DPA 2012 compliance.
Always multi-tenant; platform code lives under `back-end/src/tenant-platform/` with vertical modules under `back-end/src/verticals/restaurant/`, `back-end/src/verticals/salon/`, and `back-end/src/verticals/event/`.
- Event vertical (Phase 2–5 complete): models `Event`, `GuestList`, `TicketType`, `QRCode`, `EventBooking`, `EventBookingTransfer`, `PassSigningRequest`, `SignedPassArtifact` in `back-end/src/db/models/`; DAOs/controllers/routes/services under `back-end/src/verticals/event/`; 8 migrations including `20260814000002-create-event-booking-transfers` and `20260814000005-create-pass-signing-requests`; RBAC permissions `view_events`/`manage_events`; feature flags `event_guest_list`, `event_ticketing`, `event_qr_checkin`; business rules enforced (capacity, 24h transfer window, 24h refund window); security review + threat model + ADR + canary readiness docs in `Specs/`; QR check-in rate limiting (5 scans/sec) + device binding + HMAC signature verification; immutable `event_booking_transfers` audit table; customer-facing portal views + super-admin event management views; webhook extended for booking payments; **wallet pass signing** (Paystack payment → super-admin approval → multi-platform signing for Apple/Google/Samsung) with `passSigningRequest.dao.js`, `walletPass.service.js`, `walletPass.queue.js`, and customer portal payment flow at `/portal/events/:eventId/wallet-pass`.

- **Current session additions:**
  - Frontend wallet pass payment flow: customer portal view at `/portal/events/:eventId/wallet-pass` with Paystack redirect before "Add to Wallet" buttons (Apple Wallet, Google Pay, Samsung Pay). Status polling every 15s with auto-stop on terminal states. `eventPortalAPI.js` extended with `createWalletPassRequest`, `listWalletPassRequests`, `getWalletPassRequest` methods.
  - Event vertical Phase 5 (wallet pass signing) completion:
  - Super-admin event management UI (`SuperAdminEventManagementView.vue`)
  - Tenant event management UI (`EventManagementView.vue`, `EventFormView.vue`, `EventBookingManagementView.vue`)
  - Business rules: capacity enforcement, ticket transfer (>24h before event), cancellation refund policy (>24h before event)
  - Security review (`Specs/event-vertical-security-review.md`), threat model (`docs/threat-model-event-vertical.md`), performance review (`Specs/event-vertical-performance-review.md`), ADR (`Specs/ADR-0010-event-vertical-module.md`), canary readiness (`Specs/event-vertical-canary-deployment.md`)

## Architecture

- **Monorepo layout**: `back-end/` (Express + Sequelize + Redis/BullMQ + Socket.IO) and `front-end/` (Vue 3 + Pinia + Vuestic UI).
- **Tenant architecture**: Always multi-tenant. Tenant context resolved by `resolveTenant` middleware; all tenant-platform code under `back-end/src/tenant-platform/`. Restaurant is a vertical module under `back-end/src/verticals/restaurant/`, salon under `back-end/src/verticals/salon/`, and event under `back-end/src/verticals/event/`.
- **Three frontend entry points** (Vite dev servers):
  - Super-admin portal: `front-end/vite.config.super-admin.js` → port `8080`
  - Tenant portal: `front-end/vite.config.tenant.js` → port `8081`
  - Customer portal: `front-end/vite.config.customer.js` → port `8082`
  All three load the same `front-end/src/main.ts` Vue app. `App.vue` is now a thin error-boundary wrapper; each portal uses its own layout:
  - Super-admin: `SuperAdminLayout.vue` (`.sa-sidebar`)
  - Tenant: `TenantLayout.vue` (`.tl-sidebar`)
  - Customer/standalone: inline `standalone-sidebar` or `CustomerLandingView.vue`
- **Router**: `front-end/src/router/index.js` — standalone routes (landing, login, register, customer portal) plus conditionally added admin/tenant/salon routes. Super-admin routes are nested under `/super-admin` with `SuperAdminLayout`; tenant routes under `/admin` with `TenantLayout`. Customer portal routes use `standalone: true`.
- **Auth store**: `front-end/src/stores/auth.ts` — login, logout, getMe, settings, tenant mode, capabilities, refresh token, locale. `logout()` resets user, entryPoint, and currentTenant. `fetchTenantMode()` reuses `fetchSettings()`.
- **API interceptor**: `front-end/src/services/API.js` — queues concurrent 401s so only one refresh-token request is in flight at a time; unauthenticated `/auth/locale` requests are no longer fired from `App.vue` to avoid 401 noise.
- **Design system**: `front-end/src/assets/base.css` and `front-end/src/assets/design-system.css` define CSS custom properties for brand palette (warm browns + amber accent), typography (Fraunces + Public Sans + JetBrains Mono), spacing, radius, shadows, Vuestic overrides, modal/toast skin, skeleton loaders, and vertical accent differentiation. JS mirror tokens in `front-end/src/theme/colors.js`. Tenant branding white-labels via CSS variables (`useTenantBranding.js`). `data-vertical` attributes on `<html>` drive per-vertical accent colors for 11 verticals.
- **Auth surfaces**: Split-screen login/register flows with cinematic brand panels, glassmorphism form cards, staggered field animations, floating ambient orbs, and SVG noise grain overlays. Distinct experiences for super-admin, tenant, and customer portals.
- **Toast system**: `AppToast.vue` + `stores/toast.js` provides glassmorphism toast notifications with SVG icons, auto-dismiss progress bars, and slide-scale transitions.
- **Security hardening**: Tenant-platform controllers use explicit field allowlists to prevent mass assignment (`alertRule`, `autoScalingTrigger`, `caseStudy`, `complianceEvidence`, `incident`, `subProcessor`, `dataRetentionPolicy`, `platformReferral`, `marketplace`, `encryptionKey`). `sync.service.js` validates POS sync URLs against private/loopback IPs to prevent SSRF. `monitoring.controller.js` returns generic error messages to avoid information disclosure. `platformAudit.router.js` `/recent` requires `manage_tenants` permission.
- **Post-landing audit fixes (2026-08-06)**: Replaced clickable div logout controls with `<button>` in layouts. Added `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`, and `role="alert"` to auth form errors. Sanitized tenant branding CSS variables with `isValidHexColor()` and `isValidUrl()` before DOM injection. Allowlisted `data-vertical` attribute to `restaurant` | `salon`. Wrapped `backdrop-filter` in `@supports` with solid fallbacks and added `will-change: transform` for compositor promotion. Removed noise texture from toast to reduce repaint cost. Added Playwright `multi-tenant-flows.spec.ts` for checkout isolation, cart preservation, feature-toggle nav, and branding fallback.
- **Scale hardening (2026-08-10)**: Distributed Redis cron lock (`back-end/src/utils/redis.js`) prevents duplicate tenant-suspension runs across PM2 cluster. Tenant-aware cache wrapper (`back-end/src/utils/tenantCache.js`) prefixes keys with `tenant:{id}:` and is integrated into `schedule.dao.js`, `holiday.dao.js`, and `setting.dao.js`. Monitoring controller refactored to extract pure data-gathering functions, eliminating double-send response bugs.
- **Frontend polish (2026-08-10)**: Table/floor-plan views now have status/section filters, per-card actions, snap-to-grid editor, shape toggle, and hover tooltips. Tenant dashboard gains responsive breakpoints. Customer portal uses time-of-day greeting. Super-admin activity feed uses `<Icon>` component instead of `v-html` SVG injection.

- Tenant signup/public: `/tenant/signup`, `/api/v1/tenant-signup`
- Customer portal: `/portal`, `/portal/profile`, `/portal/reservations`, `/portal/orders`, `/portal/appointments` (salon), `/portal/gift-cards` (salon), `/portal/referrals` (salon), `/portal/packages` (salon), `/portal/loyalty`, `/portal/promotions`, `/portal/waitlist`, `/portal/events` (event), `/portal/events/:id` (event), `/portal/events/:eventId/wallet-pass` (event wallet pass payment + Add to Wallet flow)
- Salon vertical: `/appointments`, `/stations`, `/station-map`, `/services`, `/packages`, `/gift-cards`, `/referrals`, `/locations`, `/inventory`, `/expenses`, `/pricing`, `/salon/*` (settings, walkins, calendar, shifts, schedule, holidays, reports, recurring, clients, marketing, gallery, unified-schedule, whatsapp-bookings, whatsapp-payments, dashboard, staff)
- WhatsApp store locator: Inbound keywords `location`, `where`, `directions`, `find us`, `address` trigger store locator flow; multi-location asks for customer location and finds nearest via haversine.
- Tenant login by slug: `/t/:tenantSlug/login`
- Customer portal by slug: `/t/:tenantSlug/portal`

## External Integrations

- **Paystack**: GHS payments (Mobile Money, cards, bank). Platform-managed keys; rotation endpoint at `/api/v1/admin/paystack/keys/rotate`.
- **WhatsApp Business**: Ordering confirmations and support chat.
- **ShaQ Express**: Delivery partner integration with order-conversion analytics.
- **Socket.IO**: Real-time updates for reservations, orders, and support chat.

## Development Commands

```bash
# Backend
cd back-end && npm test               # Jest suite (forceExit)
npm run migrate:up                    # Apply Sequelize migrations
npm run start:dev                     # Nodemon + migrations
npm run seed:all                      # Seed database

# Frontend
cd front-end && npm run dev           # Default Vite dev server
npm run dev:super-admin               # Super-admin portal on :8080
npm run dev:tenant                    # Tenant portal on :8081
npm run dev:customer                  # Customer portal on :8082
npm run build                         # Production build
npm run lint                          # ESLint + Prettier (auto-fix)
npm run test:unit                     # Vitest (jsdom)
npm run test:a11y                     # Playwright accessibility
npm run test:visual                   # Playwright visual regression
npm run test:e2e                      # Playwright E2E
```

## Verification Gates

- **Backend**: `cd back-end && npm test` — 996 Jest tests across 143 suites; must stay green (catches cross-tenant leaks and RBAC regressions).
- **Frontend**: `cd front-end && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:unit` — lint, build, and 54 Vitest unit tests must pass.
- **API integration**: Postman collection + Newman for smoke and regression testing of `/api/v1/*` endpoints.
- **Migrations**: `npm run migrate:up` — replays from earliest unapplied migration; keep `up()` idempotent.
- **Dependency advisories**: Dependabot PRs are merged after review; recent example: postcss 8.5.23 security patch (source-map path-traversal fix).
- **Versioning**: `VERSION` file at repo root tracks current release (1.1.0); git tags mark release boundaries. `npm run version:bump -- <new-version>` syncs root `VERSION` + root `package.json`. Sub-packages (`back-end/`, `front-end/`) must be updated separately.
